hook.name: OmniHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 10 bps fee on every swap, taken from the specified input amount (exact-in) or output amount (exact-out) via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta. Fees are pooled to the hook contract and booked in a per-currency pull-payment ledger split among five hardcoded recipients, claimable by anyone via claim() or claimAll().
